To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
aerobic treatment of OFMSW before landfilling permits getting a good biological stability so to obtain a strong reduction of DOM that showed, also an aromatic character.

the aerobic treatment of organic fractions of municipal solid wastes (OFMSW) permits the biological stability of OFMSW to be obtained, so that the subsequent anaerobic process can be carried out with good results.

the aerobic biological treatment of the organic fraction of municipal solid waste is an efficient way to reduce the amount of dissolved organic matter that can leach out of landfills and contaminate the environment.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the evolution of DOM in landfill and the influence of aerobic treatment on this process.
the evolution of the DOM in the landfill and the role played by the aerobic treatment.
the study of the evolution of DOM in simulated landfill of aerobically and untreated organic fraction of municipal solid waste (MSW) and its relationship with biodegradability of the organic matter.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, the biological stability of MSW, achieved by aerobic treatment of organic fractions, is a very important factor for the reduction of the leachate production and quality.
, in landfill conditions, the presence of a high amount of DOM, especially in untreated waste, is not necessarily related with the presence of biodegradable matter.
, aerobic treatment of organic matter of MSW before landfilling is a good strategy to reduce the amount of organic matter to be degraded and to improve the stability of landfill.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

aerobic treatment of MSW allowed a better control of biological processes in landfill, reducing the production of odorous compounds, and also reducing the production of leached organic matter, with the consequent decrease of the risk of groundwater pollution.

, aerobic treatment of organic waste fraction is an effective way to improve the biological stability of waste in landfill, but it is not a sufficient condition to guarantee a long lasting biodegradation in landfill.
aerobic treatment of MSW allowed to get a biological stable material with a good potential to be used as soil conditioner, but it did not permit to reduce the content of aromatic compounds.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, in order to obtain good landfill stability, it is important to get good biological stability of the organic fraction of MSWs before its landfill disposal.
aerobic pretreatment of MSW can be a good solution to reduce leachate pollution and to increase landfill stability.
, the biological treatment of organic waste is an important tool to reduce the amount of DOM that will be released in the landfill.
